scientific_limitations: Stationary one-dimensional symmetric telegraph flips, harmonic trap, additive independent Gaussian thermal noise; no inference for inertia, biased flips, or nonlinear traps. title: A strictly negative all-rate fourth-order time arrow for a trapped telegraph particle
